eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Computer and Knowledge Engineering (ICCKE) advances computer science and engineering research, focusing on machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, natural language processing, network security, IoT, computer architecture, knowledge engineering, and cloud computing. It explores innovative algorithms, systems, architectures, and applications, emphasizing theoretical and practical contributions.
